narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates with active kinetic exchanges, an Apache shootdown, and a prolonged Hormuz blockade. Simultaneous Ukraine-Russia deep strikes and Israel's two-front war amplify the risk premium, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil and gold; short equities, particularly S&P 500 and emerging market currencies exposed to energy imports.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Impact
narratives.summary: The EIA's extended blockade timeline through Q3 2026 and Kuwait's pipeline bypass discussions confirm a structural oil supply disruption. Capital is rotating into energy equities and infrastructure plays, while inflation expectations rise, pressuring bonds.
narratives.trade_implication: Long energy sector ETFs and WTI futures; short long-duration Treasuries on sticky inflation.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Surge
narratives.summary: Despite BTC's risk-off selloff, institutional flows into crypto are accelerating, evidenced by Janus Henderson's tokenized CLO partnership with Ethena and MicroStrategy's dip buying. This signals a decoupling from macro risk in favor of long-term blockchain infrastructure plays.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate BTC on dips and buy ENA tokens; long crypto-exposed equities like MicroStrategy.
